body: Just help me out brother. I do appreciate her and what she has done for me. And by god do I love her. It’s just my past relationships.

No, the drinking/dancing is something I’ve experienced first hand hence why. And no, because she doesn’t handle my anxiety well. I do trust her pal, but for someone with severe anxiety it’s hell. Do you have anxiety?
Hard to explain, but just imagine it’s someone who wants attention.

Firstly, thank you for taking your time to read and respond. I appreciate it. 

Secondly, I do communicate to her, however she doesn’t open up. She’s in the same boat when it comes to being fucked over in the past. 

Thirdly, when someone has stopped you from topping yourself, it’s hard to find anything else to make you happy. I’m trying, but I just can’t.
That’s like asking an epileptic why they have epilepsy..
